name: FudgeMuppet
noteEs: FudgeMuppet es el dúo australiano (Scott y Michael) que se convirtió en referencia absoluta de Elder Scrolls lore desde 2014. Sus videos son largos (30-60 min), bien producidos y se dividen en dos pilares: análisis profundo de lore (historia de los Daedra, Dwemer, Aedra, los Imperios) y character builds detalladas con backstory roleplay completo. Para Skyrim son la fuente go-to si quieres entender el universo más allá de la main quest. Multi-juego dentro del franchise pero Skyrim sigue siendo su contenido más vasto.
noteEn: FudgeMuppet is the Australian duo (Scott and Michael) who became the de facto Elder Scrolls lore reference since 2014. Their videos are long (30-60 min), well-produced, and split into two pillars: deep lore analysis (history of the Daedra, Dwemer, Aedra, the Empires) and detailed character builds with full roleplay backstory. For Skyrim they're the go-to source if you want to understand the universe beyond the main quest. Multi-game within the franchise but Skyrim is still their largest body of content.
highlightsEs: Series de lore exhaustivas sobre cada Daedric Prince, los Dwemer y la historia política de Tamriel
Character builds icónicas como The Witcher, The Vampire, The Demigod — con perks, equipment y roleplay completo
Análisis de quests específicas que decodifican subtexto y conexiones con el lore mayor
Tier lists de razas, archetypes y armaduras desde una perspectiva editorial
Producción audiovisual cuidada que se diferencia de la mayoría de Skyrim YouTubers
highlightsEn: Exhaustive lore series on each Daedric Prince, the Dwemer, and Tamriel's political history
Iconic character builds like The Witcher, The Vampire, The Demigod — with perks, equipment, and full roleplay
Specific quest analyses decoding subtext and connections to the wider lore
Race, archetype, and armor tier lists from an editorial perspective
Polished audiovisual production that sets them apart from most Skyrim YouTubers
